# dsa-study-packet

> Company-neutral technical interview practice packet: source of truth for
> the practice product. Practice code, tests, notes, and generated print
> material live here; the reading site syncs content from this repo.

## Read Order

1. `AGENTS.md`: agent conduct, resident interviewer persona, practice entry
   points, public boundary
2. `TRACK-CONTRACT.md`: the versioned practice-flow contract this and future
   language tracks implement
3. `docs/guide/getting-started.md`: first rep walkthrough
4. `docs/guide/source-of-truth.md`: full layer and public-boundary contract
5. `CLAUDE.md`: Claude-specific overlay, secondary to `AGENTS.md`

## Just Command Surface

- Practice loop: `just practice-start comments|reacto|clarp|umpire [topic
  problem]`, `just practice-next`, `just practice-test`, `just
  practice-watch`, `just practice-repl`, `just practice-open`, `just
  practice-finish "<one fix>"`
- Talk-only or board: `just interview [topic problem]`, `just rep-finish
  topic problem "<line>"`
- Lookup: `just catalog "<words>"`
- Front doors: `just packet`, `just docs`, `just pdf-all`, `just test`, `just
  lint`, `just doctor`

## Machine Keys

Practice commands emit UPPERCASE key lines: `STATE`, `SOURCE`, `TEST`,
`NEXT`, `START`, `QUEUE`, `QUERY`, `MATCH`, `CHOOSE`, `SUGGEST`, `OPENED`,
`OPEN_FAILED`, `PRACTICE`, `CLOSED`, `LOGGED`, `SPACED`, `TESTS`. Catalog
readiness (`READY`, `CHOOSE`, `NOT_FOUND`) travels as a `STATE` value. Agents
relay these fields verbatim and never invent state.

## Reading Site

The published surface is [dsa-woodshed.space](https://dsa-woodshed.space), a
separate static site that reads this repo at `HEAD` and renders reference
sheets, algorithms, and docs. This repo owns the content; the site owns the
shell.

## Constraints

- Public boundary: this repo is public and company-neutral. Employer names,
  interviewer notes, request numbers, clearance facts, tailored positioning,
  and personal rep logs never enter tracked files; see
  `docs/guide/source-of-truth.md`.
- The candidate-owned practice workspace under `.challenges/` is private and
  gitignored. The harness reads it only at an explicit save-and-continue
  boundary and never scores it.
- `just` is the only front door; never invoke raw Bazel directly.
- Agents never write candidate source, tests, or private logs.
